summary: Iteration 2 testing of Kumara Hotspot ISP landing site (10+ new features). All 14 backend pytest tests pass (root, 9-package catalog, coverage for 4 supported cities incl. Cianjur/Demak/Bondowoso, Papua unsupported, empty 400, subscription create/list with new IDs, legacy id rejected 400, missing field 422, contact create/list/invalid email). Frontend critical flows verified end-to-end: promo banner appears + dismisses + persists in sessionStorage, trust 4 badges render, all 9 package WhatsApp deep-links use wa.me/628888200888 with URL-encoded package name (Gold href contains 'Gold'), recommender slider + usage buttons + result + Mbps + Pick-CTA preselect (selected platinum-2 in subscribe-package-select) + WA CTA, comparison table 7 rows, About count-up animates to 8.500+/15+/2.400 km/9 thn (locale-formatted), Coverage SVG map has all 15 city pins (jakarta, bekasi, tangerang, bogor, depok, cianjur, bandung, semarang, demak, yogyakarta, surabaya, bondowoso, denpasar, medan, makassar), coverage form Cianjur=success+emerald / Papua=warn+amber, Blog 3 cards render, Footer status badge shows 'Semua sistem normal' (ID) / 'All systems operational' (EN), Floating WhatsApp present with correct number, sticky wrapper keeps both promo banner (top=0) and header (top=48) pinned at top while scrolling, theme toggle flips body bg between rgb(10,10,10) and rgb(255,255,255), language toggle updates promo (Special Offer), footer (All systems operational), comparison rows, and blog card content to English.
critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning <span> inside <option> persists in Subscribe.jsx package select - caused by Emergent dev-overlay (x-ve-dynamic) wrapper injecting <span> into <option> children. Dev-only, won't appear in production build. Same comment carried over from iteration 1.

Promo banner i18n key uses Title-Case 'Promo Spesial' / 'Special Offer'; visual uppercase comes from CSS (tracking-wider class). The review request said 'PROMO SPESIAL tag' - matches via uppercase styling, not text content. Acceptable.

About count-up renders locale-formatted strings ('8.500+', '2.400 km') instead of raw '8500'/'2400'. This is intentional and reads better; verified the counter does animate from 0 upward via IntersectionObserver.
@app.on_event('shutdown') still deprecated; migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager (carried from iter 1).
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' via env; tighten for production (carried from iter 1).
